description: Presidential Secretariat - Commission of inquiry has been established by the Honorable President Directive dated May 31, 2022 to investigate and inquire in to the loss of life and injury Persons
reasoning: This gazette content establishes a Commission of Inquiry under the Commissions of Inquiry Act and amends its investigative timeframe. It deals with legal procedures, statutory instruments, and the establishment of a formal legal inquiry mechanism, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
